description: Book a flight against a quote_id from estimate_ad_cost, with creative assets. Price and impressions come from the stored quote — anything you send that contradicts it is ignored. Returns an order_id and a Stripe checkout URL for the exact quoted amount. Pass idempotency_key to make retries safe.

advertiser_email.description: Optional buyer email for the Stripe receipt.

audio_stream_url.description: HTTPS audio stream (required for music slots).

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reuse on retry to avoid double-booking.

image_url.description: HTTPS display creative (required for display formats).

quote_id.description: REQUIRED. The quote ID from estimate_ad_cost.

rights_confirmed.description: Must be true for music slots: you confirm licensing or ownership.

voice_script.description: 10-15s spoken script, max 35 words (required for voice_sponsor_read).

name: create_ad_order
